title: Reducing Target Group Bias in Hate Speech Detectors

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy of hate speech detection models across texts targeting different racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, South Asian, Arab, East Asian, Hispanic, African).
Measuring the variance in hate speech detection performance across texts targeting different gender identity groups (e.g., Women, Transgender, Black Women).
Comparing model classification accuracy for hate speech directed at religious groups (e.g., Jew/Jewish, Muslim/Islam).
Assessing the detection accuracy of hate speech models on texts targeting sexual minority groups (e.g., Gay, Gay Men, Homosexual).
Evaluating the performance of hate speech detectors on texts targeting immigrants and refugees.
Measuring the accuracy of hate speech classification models on texts targeting disabled individuals.
